finding.title: No check derives learned DHW windows from a profile with p60 above 1; dropping the percentile threshold is unseen
finding.claim: Mutant 41000bf52dbaa1ad at dhw_planner.py:547 (threshold = max(1.0, float(np.percentile(pattern, 60))) -> threshold = (1.0)) survives the full GATE_SCOPE=full GOLDEN_MODE=drift gate (RED-AS-NULL), yet probe_41000bf52dbaa1ad.py moves: window_hours_baseline=10.0 h vs window_hours_mutant=13.0 h.
finding.mechanism: Reach: production: a learned profile is normalised to mean 1 (DhwUsageLearner.normalize_profile), and any profile with 40 % of its hours above 1 has p60 > 1. Check that should have failed (D3.M4): tests/features.py: the window/floor block (~38020-38033, _wf_params from the house profile) and the _r7d203 window-capacity cases (~63133) derive learned windows only from the shipped profile, whose p60 is 0.83 < 1; no check derives them from a mean-1 profile whose p60 is above 1.
finding.metric_definition: hours covered by the learned DHW demand windows DhwPlanner._effective_dhw_windows derives (schedule on, no windows entered) from a mean-1 learned hourly pattern whose 60th percentile is above 1
finding.phenomenon_property: With the schedule on and no windows entered, the learned demand windows are the hours at or above max(1.0, the pattern's 60th percentile)
finding.seam_rule: awk -F'\t' '$6=="gate"' SURVIVORS.tsv (the wave list), each key's fullgate.py verdict SURVIVED or RED-AS-NULL and its probe moving
finding.proposed_fix_scope: tests only: a features.py check with a mean-1 learned pattern whose p60 exceeds 1, pinning the learned windows
